title: About
description: Priya Sinha holds healing sittings, tarot, and Vedic work in Dehradun. Fifteen years in practice. The hour is for the person in the chair.

hero.title:
Meet Priya Sinha.
Still in the work.
hero.body: Healing, tarot, and Vedic sittings in Dehradun — or by message if you cannot travel. She works with the person in front of her, not with a script.
hero.imageAlt: A quiet moment in Priya's practice

features.title: A sitting, not a package.
paragraphs: People find Divine Souls when something will not settle — a stretch of life, a question, a weight they cannot name. Priya listens first. Then she chooses the work that fits: healing, cards, ritual, or a longer course.
The hour is for one person. She has been doing this for more than fifteen years, in Dehradun and at a distance.
features.imageAlt: A guided healing moment with a singing bowl

features.title: Magic has no colour of its own.
paragraphs: Priya does not split this work into black or white. Intention does the shaping. That is the line she teaches, and the one she works by. If you come afraid of the word occult, start there.

story.title:
The will behind
the healing.
paragraphs: Divine Souls began as a quiet place to sit. Priya still works that way. People come with a matter they are actually carrying, and they leave with a next step they can use.
Her line is plain. The work has no colour of its own. Intention does the shaping. That is how these practices can be met without fear.

faq.title: About Priya, in short
faq.intro: If you want to know who she is before you write.

items.a: Priya Sinha. She holds sittings in Dehradun under Divine Souls. Lama Fera Grandmaster, High Priestess of ITW, and a meditation instructor. More than fifteen years in the work.

items.q: What does “the work has no colour” mean?
items.a: She does not split healing into black or white. What you bring, and why you bring it, is what shapes the hour.

items.q: Has she taught, or only sat with people?
items.a: Both. She teaches meditation and the methods she uses, and she still holds private sittings. Some people come for one hour. Some stay for a course.

items.q: How many people has she sat with?
items.a: More than a hundred and fifty, on the record she keeps. The number is not a sales line. It is how long the room has been open.

items.q: Can I speak to her before I book?
items.a: Yes. Call +91 7668648224, write on WhatsApp, or email priyasinha1809@gmail.com. A short first conversation is normal.
